prologue: The camera fades in to see a map of TAMRIEL, slowly panning from location to location as a voice over narration sets the current date and tone.
It is the 28th of Frostfall, in the Fourth Era 171.
act-1: EXT. IMPERIAL CITY - MARKET DISTRICT - MORNING
Golden sunlight spills over the white stone walls of THE IMPERIAL CITY. Banners sway gently above, nearby market stalls and shops hum with chatter.
Birds can be heard calling out across the stirring streets.
A world at peace – or at least pretending to be.
The camera glides downward into the MARKET DISTRICT, weaving through a bustling morning crowd.
Merchants arrange wares, Legionnaires and City Watch patrol in pairs. Citizens barter, laugh and argue.
Then, a young woman moves through it all with a quiet but urgent purpose.
ARIWYN VALGATA (19), with determination she pushes through the crowd. She doesn't shove or rush – but she doesn't exactly linger either.
She clutches a small coin pouch tightly in one hand as she continues on.
A FRUIT VENDOR steps into her path.
Fresh apples? They're straight from Chorrol!
Ariwyn offers a polite smile but keeps moving.
Maybe tomorrow, sorry I can't stop!
She sidesteps a pair of haggling merchants, arguing over the price of grain, without breaking stride.
Her eyes then flick upward as they're caught by Legion banners.
For a brief moment her pace slows, but doesn't stop.
Two IMPERIAL LEGIONNAIRES stand nearby the banner, speaking in hushed tones.
I hear they've relaxed the Legion entry requirements.
Last week. No announcement either, it just changed overnight.
Well that doesn't happen for no reason, should we be worried?
Ariwyn catches only part of their conversation, before it trails off, but just enough.
As she rounds the corner into a courtyard, she passes two ARGONIANS mid-conversation talking loudly as they walk.
They say this Arena Champion is even stronger than the last!
That's what I heard as well! Isn't she an Argonian too?
She is. I always thought I might try out for the arena, you know.

The Argonians move out of earshot. The determination on her face falters for a moment, nearly getting distracted, then pushing through the feeling and carrying onwards with the same urgency as before.
